_help: Quiz page (index.php). The questions come from the funnel API; this file groups them into screens and sets the on-screen text. The quiz itself is drawn by assets/funnel.js.
title: Complete your intake today!
_title_help: Used only when the API form has no name.
_auto_continue_help: Picking a matching answer submits the screen by itself — the same as pressing Continue — once every question on the screen is answered. auto_continue_options = exact answers (any case); auto_continue_patterns = regular expressions tested against the start of the answer (any case). Checkbox, radio and select questions only.
_questions_help: Display settings per API question key. prechecked: checkbox starts ticked (the visitor can untick it). compact: only the checkbox line, no title. text: shown instead of the API option text (the saved answer stays the API option). required_message: error when a required checkbox is left unticked.

sms_consent.required_message: Please agree to receive clinician and delivery texts to continue.

_skip_questions_help: API question keys left out of the quiz (not shown, validated or saved here). The shipping address is asked on the checkout page instead.
_screens_help: One screen at a time. keys = API question keys. heading/text/badge/button are optional (a screen with one question uses its label as the heading); badge defaults to the API step name; badge_style: info | success; doctor: show the clinician photo. Keys not in the API are ignored; API questions not listed are added after these screens automatically. A screen whose questions are all hidden by conditions is skipped.
